raw_snippet: CWDL Rebrands as Advisent, Joins Current
value_text: announced as joining its group: CWDL (rebranded Advisent) (accounting firm, USA)
note: Announced as the firm 'joining' the alliance; Crete/Current's model is buying a majority of the firm's non-attest practice, but the page does not state the stake. Page text now shows the rebranded name Current. Attest work stays in a separate LLP (alternative practice structure).
